metadata.description: Twenty-seven-item parent or teacher screening questionnaire for autistic traits in school-age children.
metadata.intended_use: School and clinical screening support for children with possible autism-spectrum characteristics.
metadata.name_origin: Autism Spectrum Screening Questionnaire, abbreviated ASSQ.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a brief observer screening instrument for Asperger/autism-spectrum characteristics in school-age children.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Observable social, communication, and behavior characteristics are sampled across everyday school-age functioning.
metadata.interpretation_notes: The ASSQ is a screening aid, not a diagnostic test; use German validation and informant-specific guidance.

versions.source_citation: ASSQ German validation reference for autism-spectrum traits in school-age children.
